verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework with a hosted platform, so issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair axis. The pack has no evidence of issuing per-agent API keys or scoped tokens. The only access-control mention is a pricing-page line about Enterprise 'RBAC, SSO, IAM, and network policy integration'. That line is about organizational access controls and does not describe credential issuance or scoping for agents.
